	from = {
		has_country_flag = dtp_ed_open
		check_variable = {
			which = dtp_edtab
			value = 11
		}
		check_variable = {
			which = dtp_edcat
			value = 6
		}
		check_variable = {
			which = dtp_edpg
			value = 2
		}
	}
	from = {
		has_country_flag = dtp_ok_tc
	}
	NOT = {
		AND = {
			exists = event_target:dtp_lv
			event_target:dtp_lv = {
				dtp_lc_com = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

	optimize_memory
